description: Change a scrape job: send job_id and only the fields you want to change, at least one. Set plan_selector to null to clear it. Hosted scraping is behind a release flag: until it is on for your workspace this answers 501 hosted_scraping_not_enabled. Runs honour robots.txt and fetch only public https pages. Needs a Last Price credential with the commerce:configure scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

auto_contribute.description: Whether run results are contributed to the shared price pool.

currency.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 code, such as USD.

extraction_mode.description: css reads the selectors only; css_with_llm_fallback asks a model when they find nothing.

job_id.description: The scrape job UUID: id on a list_scrape_jobs result.

plan_selector.description: CSS selector for the plan name beside each price.

price_selector.description: CSS selector for the price elements.

schedule.description: How often the job runs. manual runs only with run_scrape_job.

url.description: The public page to read. Must start with https://.

vertical.description: The vertical the prices belong to, such as saas.

name: update_scrape_job
